locations.title: Stasis Field Projector
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Side quest [Rupert the Gunsmith](#loc=70335)

Immediately after entering Rupert's flat in [Rupert's Apartment Building](#loc=69485), turn left and head to the opposite wall of the play room to find the pink teddy bear sitting on a pile of cushions.  Use the action key to trigger a voice response from the bear.  Repeat this action many times until the bear explodes - revealing the blueprint in its place.

The Stasis Field Projector itself is a throwable weapon that emits electricity before exploding, dealing no damage but lifting zombies into the air before slamming them back down. It does not affect Human Allies or Human Enemies.

locations.title: Right hand of gloVA
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin side quest [Do You Believe?](#loc=70341) to gain access to this building

You must first obtain both [Right hand of gloVA piece #1](#loc=70357) and [Right hand of gloVA piece #2](#loc=70358).  Find the skull on the rock near the burning incense at this location and insert both pieces into it.  Then the final blueprint will be revealed.

**Note:** The blueprint is titled Right hand of gloVA on PC, and Right ball of gloVA on console.

**Note 2:** Both pieces must be gathered in the same play session.

locations.title: Clicker (The Last of Us)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [The Bunker](#loc=70333)

 (* The upgrade is identical to the 'King' mod, but sells for twice as much.)
